title: Business Development Executive
description:
My client is looking for for a proactive, driven and commercially minded New Business Development Executive to join our growing sales team.

This is an outbound-focused role, responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities across the education and public sectors. You will play a key role in opening doors to new organisations, re-engaging lapsed accounts and generating high-quality sales opportunities for our senior Business Development Managers and Account Managers.

You will be responsible for high-volume outbound prospecting, engaging with prospective customers, understanding their technology requirements and identifying opportunities around IT infrastructure, networking, cyber security, cloud solutions and managed services.

Key Responsibilities

New Business Prospecting

Lead Generation & Opportunity Identification

Opportunity Qualification

Decision-Maker Engagement

Meeting Generation

CRM & Campaign Management

They are looking for someone who is naturally confident on the telephone, commercially aware and motivated by the challenge of generating new business.

You will be comfortable making outbound calls throughout the day, approaching organisations with whom you have no existing relationship and confidently engaging with prospective customers.

Experience & Background
- Ideally 12+ months' experience in outbound telesales, telemarketing, lead generation, technology sales or an IT reseller / VAR environment.
- Experience selling into the education or public sectors would be advantageous.
- Alternatively, we would welcome candidates from other sectors who can demonstrate a strong track record in cold calling, prospecting and new-business development.

Skills & Attributes
- Confident and professional telephone manner with strong communication skills.
- Comfortable undertaking high-volume outbound calling and proactive prospecting.
- Resilient, tenacious and able to handle rejection positively.
- Strong questioning, listening and opportunity qualification skills.
- Organised, self-motivated and capable of managing a structured prospecting routine.
- Commercially minded, with the ability to identify potential sales opportunities and understand customer requirements.
- A target-driven approach with a genuine desire to achieve and exceed activity and performance objectives.

Technical Knowledge
- An understanding of IT infrastructure, managed services, networking and cyber security would be beneficial.
- Familiarity with technologies such as Aruba, Fortinet, Cisco Meraki, Microsoft 365 and Azure would be advantageous.
- Experience using CRM systems, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365, and sales prospecting tools would be desirable.

title: Business Development Executive - Part time
description:
Position: Business Development Executive

Location: Oxfordshire (initial training in Eynsham, then home-based with regular office days)

Salary: £15,188 per annum + uncapped commission (OTE around £36,000)

Hours: 22.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 2pm

Contract: Permanent

Experience: Business Development Executive, Sales, Business Development, Telephone Sales, Lead Generation, Appointment Setting, Customer Service, B2 B Sales, Working to Targets, Relationship Building, Oxfordshire, Home-Based Working

The Opportunity

Thompson & Terry Recruitment are delighted to be working with a growing Oxfordshire radio station who are looking to recruit a proactive Business Development Executive to join their team, initially completing training in person before working remotely from home.

As Business Development Executive, you will focus on generating new business across Oxfordshire, helping local businesses reach customers through radio advertising and sponsorship opportunities. You will be responsible for building your own pipeline through cold outreach, starting conversations with business owners and developing these opportunities into advertising campaigns and sponsorship partnerships.

The successful Business Development Executive will identify and approach prospective advertisers through cold calls, personalised emails and local business networking. You will arrange meetings to understand each business's goals, recommend suitable advertising opportunities and manage the sales process from initial contact through to proposal, negotiation and agreement. You will also maintain accurate records of prospects, conversations and next steps, while working with the wider team to ensure advertisers receive a smooth start and positive experience.

This position would suit a confident communicator who is comfortable building relationships, enjoys speaking with people and is keen to develop a career in sales. Benefits include home-based working following training, uncapped commission, full training and ongoing coaching.

The Company

Our client is a growing Oxfordshire radio business focused on helping businesses reach local customers through radio advertising and sponsorship. The business has a new local newsroom on the way, an expanding digital offering and plans for its app.

The opportunity offers the chance to sell advertising and sponsorship with a strong connection to Oxfordshire, working directly with local businesses to understand their goals and recommend suitable opportunities.

The successful Business Development Executive will take responsibility for their own sales pipeline and work independently, while collaborating with the wider team to provide advertisers with a smooth experience after securing their business.

Requirements
- Confident communicator, comfortable making outbound telephone calls
- Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills
- Organised with excellent follow-up and time management skills
- Resilient and motivated, with the ability to work towards targets
- Able to work independently from home and manage your own workload
- Keen to learn, develop and respond positively to feedback
- Previous experience in sales, customer service, retail, hospitality or a target-driven environment would be advantageous

Thompson & Terry Ltd, trading as Thompson & Terry Recruitment, are an Abingdon-based recruitment agency specialising in placing candidates into roles across Oxfordshire and beyond. We typically recruit for Office Administration Jobs, Sales Jobs, Marketing Jobs, Biotech Jobs, and Executive Search appointments.

No terminology used in this advert is intended to discriminate on the grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified individuals.

If you have any accessibility requirements or would like to discuss reasonable adjustments in the recruitment process, please let us know.

PLEASE NOTE: Due to a high volume of applications, if you have not heard from us within 5 working days, unfortunately, your application has been unsuccessful at this time.

title: Graduate Medical Sales Representative - Dermatology & Allergy
description:
Evolve Selection is exclusively partnering with a leading global pharmaceutical company to deliver an exciting new team build across the UK.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a brand-new team as a Healthcare Partnership Associate, representing an innovative portfolio of products across Dermatology and Allergy. You'll have the opportunity to help shape and grow a developing team, build valuable relationships across primary care and make a real contribution to improving patient outcomes.

Combining scientific engagement, relationship building and commercial ownership, you'll work in partnership with healthcare professionals to identify opportunities, develop your territory and deliver meaningful value across these exciting therapeutic areas.

Whether you're a recent graduate looking to launch your career in the pharmaceutical industry, an entry-level sales professional ready for your next step, or an experienced medical sales professional seeking a new challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Previous pharmaceutical experience is not essential, with training and development available to support those new to the industry.

This is a full-time, permanent position covering the South Central region of the UK, with exact territory boundaries to be confirmed. Please note that a full, valid UK driving licence is essential for this role.

What s on offer?
- Highly Competitive starting salary of £35,000, plus exceptional benefits package - including bonus, car allowance, pension, holiday buy back scheme and more!
- Innovative Product Portfolio - Work with leading dermatology and allergy products in a specialist market.
- Collaborative Culture - Thrive in a supportive, people-focused environment.

Ideal Requirements:
- Open to Graduates and Entry-Level Professionals - Previous pharmaceutical experience is not essential. We welcome applications from graduates and early-career professionals with transferable skills, enthusiasm and a desire to build a career in pharmaceutical sales.
- A Passion for Healthcare and Learning - A degree in a scientific, healthcare or related discipline is desirable, alongside a genuine interest in healthcare and a willingness to develop strong clinical and product knowledge. We welcome applications from both experienced professionals and graduates with transferable skills who are keen to build a career in pharmaceutical sales.
- Strong Relationship-Building and Communication Skills - The ability to build credible, lasting relationships with healthcare professionals and other key stakeholders. You will be confident communicating, influencing and adapting your approach to meet different customer needs.
- Commercial Awareness and a Drive to Succeed - A proactive, results-focused mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities, work towards objectives and contribute to business growth. Previous experience in a target-driven commercial or healthcare environment would be advantageous.
- Self-Motivation and Effective Territory Management - The confidence and initiative to work independently, manage your time effectively and take ownership of a geographical territory. You will be organised, adaptable and comfortable planning your activities to maximise opportunities.
- A Commitment to Professional Excellence - A commitment to working ethically and responsibly within the pharmaceutical industry. An understanding of the ABPI Code, previous pharmaceutical sales experience and an ABPI qualification would be advantageous, although support and development will be available for candidates new to the industry.

Role Responsibilities:
- Build Meaningful Healthcare Partnerships - Develop trusted, long-term relationships with GPs, practice-based clinicians, community pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, becoming a valued partner and a recognised source of clinical and product expertise within your territory.
- Drive Territory Growth and Commercial Success - Take ownership of your territory, identifying new opportunities, developing strategic business plans and using sales data and market insights to maximise growth, achieve sales targets and deliver outstanding commercial results.
- Deliver Engaging, Clinically Relevant Customer Conversations - Bring clinical evidence to life through high-quality, tailored discussions that demonstrate the benefits, appropriate use and value of specialist products, supporting healthcare professionals to make informed decisions that benefit patients.
- Shape Local Healthcare Opportunities Through Collaboration - Work closely with internal colleagues and cross-functional teams to develop effective engagement strategies, strengthen local partnerships and align product offerings with NHS priorities and evolving patient needs, including opportunities within Pharmacy First.
- Champion Professional Excellence and Patient Outcomes - Operate with integrity and professionalism, maintaining excellent clinical and product knowledge while ensuring all activities meet ABPI and regulatory standards. Keep patients at the heart of every interaction and ensure responsible use of resources.

Recruitment Process:

2 stage interview and assessment process

Interview with a hiring manager who is a passionate and experienced leader, values your ideas, mentors your growth, and is committed to helping you succeed in this role.

Excited to learn more? Click apply or reach out to our recruitment team for full details!

Application Process:

Evolve Selection acts as a recruitment partner on behalf of our clients. All applications are reviewed by our specialist consultants and assessed against the specific requirements of the role. Suitable candidates will be contacted for an initial discussion before being introduced to the hiring client.

We appreciate every application; however, due to application volumes, we may not be able to respond to all candidates individually. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days, please consider your application unsuccessful for this particular role, however we may contact you regarding future opportunities that match your experience in line with our privacy policy.

Evolve is a leading recruitment and outsourcing organisation, operating within the Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Medical Device and Life Science sectors.

Equal opportunities are important to us. We believe that diversity and inclusion are critical to our success as a company, We encourage applications from everyone, regardless of background, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, ethnicity, belief, age, family or parental status, and any other characteristic.

title: Account Manager
description:
Are you a commercially minded relationship builder who enjoys working closely with customers and helping businesses grow?

Our client is a specialist manufacturing business supplying high-performance products into demanding engineering markets. As part of their continued growth, they are seeking an Account Manager to manage and develop key customer relationships, drive account growth, and provide vital support to the commercial team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in account management, sales support, customer service, or commercial coordination within a B2 B or manufacturing environment. Working closely with senior leadership, you will play a key role in developing customer relationships, managing sales activities, and ensuring opportunities progress through the pipeline effectively.

Key Responsibilities
- Building strong relationships with customer contacts and key stakeholders
- Conducting regular account reviews and identifying opportunities for growth
- Following up quotations and maintaining engagement throughout the sales cycle
- Gathering customer feedback and analysing reasons for won and lost business
- Supporting the delivery of customer commitments by liaising with internal teams
- Researching and engaging prospective customers to generate new opportunities
- Supporting customer visits, exhibitions, trade shows, and industry events
- Maintaining accurate CRM records, activities, and pipeline data
- Producing presentations, proposals, and customer-facing sales materials
- Preparing meeting briefs, reports, and follow-up actions
- Assisting with regular sales and pipeline reporting

About You

We're looking for an organised and proactive individual who enjoys building relationships and maintaining momentum across multiple customer accounts.

Essential Experience
- Previous experience in account management, customer service, sales support, or commercial coordination within a B2 B environment
- Experience building and maintaining professional customer relationships
- Daily use of a CRM system
- Strong administrative and organisational skills

Skills & Attributes
- Strong IT skills, including PowerPoint and Excel
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Highly organised with strong attention to detail and follow-up skills
- Confident communicating with customers both remotely and face-to-face
- Professional, trustworthy, and discreet

Additional Information
- Office-based in Banbury, Oxfordshire
- Full right to work in the UK required
- Opportunity to join a growing and innovative manufacturing business
- Full-time position, with part-time applications also considered for the right candidate

To discuss this opportunity, please apply with your CV or contact us directly for further information.
